m1.title: Tools and wire

m2.title: 200A residential panel
m2.desc: Kill the main, verify dead, install breakers, land hot/neutral/ground, neutral-ground bond only at the main.

m3.title: Rough-in from the plan
m3.desc: Mount boxes, drill studs, home runs, staple cable, label.

m5.title: Troubleshooting
m5.desc: Multimeter readings, open neutral, tripped breaker, dead outlet.

m6.title: Commercial
m6.desc: EMT bending (90, offset, saddle), pulling THHN, 3-phase 208/120 and 480/277.

m8.title: Data center
m8.desc: Cable tray, busway, UPS, PDUs, redundant A/B feeds.

m9.title: Reading plans
m9.desc: Symbols, panel schedules and basic load calculation.

m10.title: Foreman mode
m10.desc: Read the plan, do the takeoff, assign tasks to your crew and inspect their work.
